title: Periodicity of weight enumerators for codes generated by an integral matrix
summary: In the theory of error-correcting codes, the minimum weight and the weight enumerator play a crucial role in evaluating the error-correcting performance. In this paper, by viewing the weight enumerator as a quasi-polynomial, we reduce the determination of the minimum weight of the resulting family to finitely many representative values of $q$. We also give a transformation formula between the Tutte quasi-polynomial and the weight enumerator.
